# specfun-py — Zhang & Jin special functions for Python, regenerated

Python bindings for the netlib **specfun** collection (Zhang & Jin, 1996
Wichita State technical report / ACM transactions): gamma, digamma,
exp integrals, Dawson's integral, Bessel I0/I1/K0/K1, erf/erfc — the
plain double-precision functions.

**These bindings were not written by hand.** They were generated by
[nativegate](https://github.com/ravikings/nativegate) directly from the
original Fortran in this repository's `services/specfun/native/`, so
every function's route to your CPU is: unchanged F77 → f2py-generated
extension → Python function.

The source is unchanged: the files mark their single/double dialects by
commenting every statement in both (`CS`-single, `CD`-double), and
nativegate's `dialect: cd` setting resolves the marking into the build
copy under `native/_expanded/`. The committed `.f` files are the netlib
downloads byte for byte; PROVENANCE.md carries the URLs and hashes.

## Install / build

The golden tape (`services/specfun/golden.json`) pins the return values
of all 14 entry points; `ngate golden verify specfun` fails a rebuild
that moved a digit.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ravikings/specfun-py
cd specfun-py
pip install "nativegate[clang,build]"   # needs cmake, ninja, gfortran
pip install -e "services/specfun[build,test]"
ngate build specfun
python -m pytest services/specfun/tests -q
```

Smoke check:

```python
import specfun as sf
sf.DGAMMA(5.0)   # 24.0
sf.DERF(1.0)     # 0.8427007929497148 — bit-identical to Python's math.erf
```

## API

| Function | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `DGAMMA(x)` | gamma(x) |
| `DLGAMA(x)` | ln gamma(x) |
| `PSI(x)` | digamma(x) |
| `DAW(x)` | Dawson's integral |
| `EI(x)`, `EONE(x)`, `EXPEI(x)` | exp integrals |
| `DERF(x)`, `DERFC(x)`, `DERFCX(x)` | error function family |
| `BESI0(x)`, `BESI1(x)`, `BESK0(x)`, `BESK1(x)` | modified Bessel functions |

## What nativegate contributed

Everything on the Python/consumer side: the f2py GenerateMakefile path,
the CMake build, the wheel, the package layout, the generated pytest
suite, the FastAPI service and Dockerfile (not packaged here), and the
golden-record regression harness. The Fortran is untouched numerics.
Bugs this first contact with specfun surfaced in the generator are
recorded in nativegate's DEFECTS list.
